verdict.rationale: New Relic docs confirm vendor-maintained APM agents for major languages, infrastructure monitoring for hosts/containers/providers/network, OpenTelemetry support, Kubernetes/cloud cost visibility, and Lambda serverless monitoring—covering the breadth of hosts, containers, K8s, and cloud services the story asks for. However, community reports flag real friction (fragile in-cluster collection services, a logging-agent bug that dropped logs) suggesting operational rough edges rather than pure vendor-doc perfection. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of Kubernetes-specific agent reliability, dedicated K8s integration docs beyond generic infra visibility, and confirmation that in-cluster collection issues have been resolved.
